from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its title and case cause."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title/heading of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The legal case cause (案由) identified in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document (e.g., 二审判决书, 再审裁定书, 决定书)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
